# agentsmd

> CI gate that fails when your AGENTS.md starts lying. Statically verifies
> the references an AGENTS.md makes: backticked file paths, relative
> markdown links, make/npm/pnpm/yarn/bun script invocations, and stated Go
> and Node versions against go.mod and package.json. No LLM calls, no code
> execution.

## Usage

- GitHub Actions: `- uses: ofershap/agentsmd@v0.1.0` is the whole workflow step.
- Local/any CI: run the agentsmd binary; `agentsmd check` reports drift with fix hints.
- `-format sarif` emits SARIF for GitHub code scanning annotations.
- Exit 1 on drift so the build goes red the day instructions stop matching the repo.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ofershap/agentsmd#readme): what it checks, usage, limits
